About Me

Professional Summary

Mechatronics Engineering graduate (Yıldız Technical University, 2026) with hands-on experience in quality control, embedded systems, and automation project development across hydraulics, robotics, and industrial manufacturing. Skilled in mechanical design (SolidWorks), embedded programming (Python, C, ESP32/PIC), and real-time control and vision systems, with a track record of delivering multidisciplinary projects from concept to functional prototype.

Native Arabic speaker with advanced English (C1) and near-native Turkish (C2). Eager to contribute to innovative engineering teams in mechatronics, automation, production, or controls, and open to relocation for international career opportunities.
